pages.article_html:
A New Master

Level 4 · Adventuring · Tanvu · Kojan

<Class Instructor> can be found near the water on the western side of Dallerjuba's beach.

Objectives

Locate Ikolo for further training. She can often be found meditating near the graveyard, just north of the village.

Description

This quest varies from city to city. It is given as you level up to point you to the proper trainer. The actual NPC varies by your city and class.

What they say

On offering it

the source records these words but names no speaker
===Heavy Fighter Dialogue=== "There are a few individuals hidden in this village with gifts not unlike yours. However, they have spent many years honing and finding their abilities under careful tutelage." "For instance, a man named Shen Karr often practices his techniques along the southern tip of the beach. His prowess with a blade is matched by very few." "You will be able to learn much from him. Perhaps he will even lend you the old training sword I gave him several years ago." ===Light Fighter Dialogue=== ===Caster Dialogue=== ===Healer Dialogue===

Recorded by fandom page.

Talriia Arkenar
Talriia says, "You! Dread Knight! My master has heard of your rapid progress and wishes to speak with you. Head through the passage southwest of here and look for Ryldrak Kiltlar. You won't regret it." RSS Comments

Recorded by vg.curse.com.

Old Man Kanjaro
"There are a few individuals hidden in this village with gifts not unlike yours. However, they have spent many years honing and refining their abilities under careful tutelage." "There is a particular person I believe can help you. Her name is Ikolo. As the village healer, Ikolo has rescued countless souls using her mastery over Jin." "Long ago, I forced her hand to learn the art of combat in order to protect herself. She may even still have the mace I let her borrow."

Recorded by vg.curse.com.

Notes

Casters Taash (near docks) Light Fighters Aniji (near docks) Heavy Fighter Shen Karr (beach near docks) Healer Ikolo (shrine on ridge above village)

detail_observations.html: On offering it

detail_observations.label: What they say
detail_observations.text: Old Man Kanjaro "You have no weapons and no armor." The old man chuckles. "How long has it been without the emperor's hand to guide you? How long since you have made a decision for yourself? I can put you on a path to redemption, but you must choose to walk it." "Many villagers here are lost - displaced because of the emperor. They need your help. Help as many villagers as you can here and return to me." "It's time now to rely on your own strength, intellect, and wisdom; not the emperor's."

A Humble New Beginning

Level 3 · Adventuring · Tanvu · Kojan

Using nothing but raw skill and your bare hands, assist at least three Dallerjuba Villagers and return to Old Man Kanjaro.

Objectives

Assist 3 Dellerjuba Villagers

Description

1) Speak to Old Man Kanjaro in Tanvu. 2) Speak to three Dellerjuba Villagers, assisting them. 3) Return to Old Man Kanjaro.

What they say

On offering it

Old Man Kanjaro
"You have no weapons and no armor." The old man chuckles. "How long has it been without the emperor's hand to guide you? How long since you have made a decision for yourself? I can put you on a path to redemption, but you must choose to walk it." "Many villagers here are lost - displaced because of the emperor. They need your help. Help as many villagers as you can here and return to me." "It's time now to rely on your own strength, intellect, and wisdom; not the emperor's."

Recorded by vg.curse.com.

Notes

Meat for Tanvu (2) Turtle Soup (2) One Hand Clapping (2) A Lost Memento (3) Rival Fisherman (2)

findings.observation: A New Master displays level 4, Tanvu, starters Old Man Kanjaro and Talriia Arkenar, Hand in to Vornril Xundan and Previous Redemption. Its Next field includes A New Master itself and A Humble New Beginning. The self-link is retained as source evidence, not an enforced chain.

The primary objective names Ikolo near the graveyard; the Fandom alternate says seek your trainer. Description explicitly says NPC varies by city and class. Anonymous heavy-fighter dialogue names Shen Karr, Talriia dialogue names Ryldrak Kiltlar, and Kanjaro dialogue names Ikolo. These accounts remain separate from the Vornril Xundan hand-in field. Seven attributed disagreements cover ends npc, levels, starts npc and starts zone.

A Humble New Beginning displays level 3, starter and hand-in Old Man Kanjaro, Previous Redemption and Next Finding Oki. Its main objective says assist 3 Dellerjuba Villagers; Fandom and screenshot-attributed alternatives retain an assisted counter of 3. Four disagreements cover level, next quest and starts zone. Notes list five candidate named quests but do not establish which combinations satisfy the counter.

Redemption Next A New Master agrees with that page Previous Redemption. A Humble New Beginning also displays Previous Redemption while A New Master lists it under Next. These edges do not establish a single linear progression. Shared archive transcriptions and referenced mirrors are not independent corroboration.

A New Master displays six reward item tooltips without proving all are simultaneous awards. A Humble New Beginning explicitly displays Coin reward 60 c; this literal denomination is retained without treating other unitless coin displays as copper. Coordinates in detail fields and the shared map spot remain separate contexts.
